request.missing_relation: Whether prior work has studied episode-level PM2.5 persistence conditional on calm-to-directional wind transitions or rising wind speed, especially in Beijing hourly observations.
request.query: (Beijing OR China) AND (PM2.5 OR fine particulate) AND (episode duration OR persistence OR pollution episode) AND (calm OR wind direction OR wind speed OR transition)
request.change_if_found: If a close study uses essentially this conditional episode-persistence contrast, do not claim world novelty; narrow I1 to a distinct exposure definition, missingness-aware measurement test, or prospective temporal-transfer test. With titles alone, record a lead and make no detailed comparison.

result.scope: Crossref metadata; original abstracts only when present
